{{Quote|This is where the Mandalorian War started? This doesn't look like much of a battlefield.''"<br />"''Much is buried here, and there is much that should remain buried.|[[Atton Rand]] and [[Kreia]]|<ref name="TSL" />}}
'''Dxun''' {{Pronounced|'dʌ.ksɪn}}, also known as the '''Demon Moon''', was the largest of four [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that orbited the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Like its parent planet, it was covered almost entirely by dense jungles that were populated by many [[Species/Legends|species]] of fierce, predatory animals.

==Description==
{{Quote|Blasted jungle's taking over everything!|[[Zuka]]|<ref name="TSL" />}}
[[File:Dxun_approach.jpg|thumb|left|140px|Joining of the Dxun and the [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]] in [[3996 BBY]]]]

Despite being temperate and habitable, the jungles of Dxun posed major challenges for its inhabitants. Due to its constant rains and wet climate, mechanical devices did not last long and required continuous maintenance. Moreover, the jungles were inhabited by many dangerous predators such as [[boma]]s, [[cannok]]s, [[drexl]]s, [[maalraas]], [[skreev]]s, and [[Zakkeg/Legends|zakkegs]], forcing the moon's inhabitants to be armed at all times.<ref name="TSL" />

Though considered a moon of Onderon, Dxun and Onderon were almost sister planets. They were so close to one another that it was only a short shuttle ride between them,<ref name="TSL" /> and they even shared a bit of the same atmosphere. Every year, during Dxun's summer season, the atmospheres of Onderon and Dxun would connect.<ref name="sithwar6">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref> This allowed the vicious drexls to wander and settle on Onderon, laying the foundations for the [[Beast Wars]].<ref name="totj1">[[Tales of the Jedi 1|''Tales of the Jedi'' 1]]</ref>

==History==
===Early history===
{{Quote|The jungles of Dxun are filled with deadly predators. They will stalk you day and night, and the moment you let your guard down they will strike.|[[Qordis]]'s ghost|<ref name="rot">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Mandalore.jpg|thumb|150px|The death of Mandalore the Indomitable on Dxun]]

At the end of the Beast Wars, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]] relocated the sarcophagus of [[Freedon Nadd]], the former [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[King/Legends|King]] of Onderon, from Onderon to Dxun,<ref name="nadd2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 2]]</ref> in an attempt to prevent the [[Naddist|Naddists]] from drawing on its power.<ref name="nadd1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 1]]</ref> Despite this, [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] would later manage to enter the [[Tomb of Freedon Nadd]] on Dxun.<ref name="darklords2">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 2]]</ref>

At the end of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] in [[3996 BBY]], [[Mandalore the Indomitable]], leader of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], was eaten alive by the vicious beasts of Dxun.<ref name="sithwar6" />

===Mandalorian Wars===
{{Quote|We claimed this moon decades ago when we reforged ourselves after Exar Kun's defeat. Some of us call it home.|A [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusader]], circa [[3951 BBY]]|<ref name="TSL" />}}
After assuming the leadership of the Mandalorians, [[Mandalore the Ultimate]] made Dxun his stronghold, from which he planned his attack on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TSL" />

In [[3963 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian Wars]] expanded into a galaxy-wide conflict when the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders invaded the Republic. From their headquarters on Dxun, Mandalore's forces attacked and took nearby Onderon in mere hours. A battle with the Republic forces took place on the moon, but it was little more that a rear-guard holding action by the Republic.

[[File:FreedonNaddTempleExterior.jpg|thumb|left|The final resting site of Freedon Nadd]]
Years later, after the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak]] had entered the war and pushed the Mandalorian forces back to their original Dxun staging grounds, a far bloodier battle was fought. The Republic attempted to capture the [[Mandalorian Outpost (Dxun)|Mandalorian headquarters]] on Dxun. Republic forces defeated the Mandalorians, but at a heavy cost. The Mandalorian outposts were entrenched and well defended by hidden mines, traps, anti-air turrets, and the ferocious inhabitants of the jungle itself. During the bloody battle, the Republic lost ten soldiers for every Mandalorian killed. [[Meetra Surik]], who was in command of the battle, was forced to sacrifice dozens of her soldiers, sending them on a suicidal charge to disable the minefield that was the last obstacle keeping them away from the Mandalorian fortress.<ref name="TSL" />

After the battle, the Republic military did not bother to demolish many structures that the Mandalorians had built, nor did they uncover the many hidden weapons caches providently left in case the Mandalorians were someday to return.<ref name="TSL" />

===Onderon Civil War===
[[File:DxunConceptArt.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Remnants of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]]]
In [[3956 BBY]], [[Canderous Ordo]] took the title of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] and gathered a handful of Mandalorians, most of whom were mercenaries at the time, on the Dxun moon, in the rebuilt headquarters of the old Mandalore. There they regrouped, concealing their presence from both the Republic and the native Onderonians, silencing all scouts who came anywhere near their encampment. Canderous hoped that, one day, the Mandalorians of Dxun would regain their former glory.<ref name="TSL" />

Meetra Surik landed in the jungles of Dxun when her ship, the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'', was severely damaged in a [[Blockade of Onderon|space battle over Onderon]] where Republic forces commanded by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Tobin (Human)|Tobin]] attacked them unprovoked, almost definitely under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vaklu]]'s orders. While exploring the jungle, Surik was [[Skirmish on Dxun|attacked]] by three of the [[Zhug brothers]], who were also stranded by the space battle and looking to collect on her bounty. Later, Surik was discovered by a group of Mandalorians, who brought her to the new Mandalore. She needed to get to Onderon to search for Jedi Master [[Kavar]], but Canderous told her that she would need to prove herself first. Surik performed several tasks for the Mandalorians and proved herself honorable, and Canderous made good on his word, providing a shuttle and accompanying her to the city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]].<ref name="TSL" />

[[File:Dxun_ebon.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'' taking off from Dxun]]
When the [[Onderon Civil War]] erupted, the Mandalorians [[Battle of Onderon (Onderon Civil War)|fought]] alongside Meetra Surik, despite, or perhaps because of, her involvement in their [[Battle of Malachor V|defeat]] at [[Malachor V]]. Canderous provided the Exile with a repaired [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]] (several of its minor systems were malfunctioning) so that she could get into Iziz. Meanwhile, the Mandalorians and a party of Surik's companions headed into the jungle to fight [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vaklu]]'s [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] allies, who landed on Dxun via a craft of a [[KT-400 military droid carrier]]'s design. They found the Sith inside and outside the Tomb of Freedon Nadd, where they were conducting a ritual to keep Onderon beasts under the control of Sith beastmasters.<ref name="TSL" />

[[File:Dxun_mist.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The Dxun jungle from above]]
The party started at a tunnel where they had to get through a minefield and disable a motion-sensing alarm for alerting the Sith of a hostile presence. After, doing that, they disabled a power generator that controlled the droid sentry force of the [[Tomb of Freedon Nadd|Tomb]] and continued to neutralize three [[Sith trooper (Sith Empire)|Sith troopers]] and a [[Sith officer]] who were guarding a terminal, what looked like a storage shed and the Sith's transport near the Tomb entrance. They then initiated a program via the terminal to order the mechanical sentry force (droids and turrets) to attack all hostiles and friendlies in the area, reducing the amount of the Sith Surik's party's needed to take care of. The party continued to charge the Tomb entrance, which was heavily guarded by [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] Apprentices, Sith troopers and Sith Commandos&mdash;all of which were taken out, allowing Surik's party to proceed into the Tomb itself. After battling Sith Commandos, Sith troopers, [[Sith officer]]s, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], [[Sentinel droid|Sith War Droid]], [[Boma]] beasts, and Dark Jedi Apprentices to clear the tomb of all enemies, the party opened a locked door via an ancient terminal and met two Dark Jedi Masters and a [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] performing a ritual, which would put the Bomas under control of the Sith force attacking Onderon. They accomplished their task before Surik's party reached them. Following the confrontation, the Sith Master attempted to corrupt the party's leader to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] but was unsuccessful. The three Sith then went on the offensive; however, they were bested, resulting in their death. The party leader then removed Freedon Nadd's lightsaber from his sarcophagus and met up with [[Xarga]], who brought Surik's party back to the ''Ebon Hawk'' and told them of Surik's successful mission to bring peace to Onderon.<ref name="TSL" />

===Galactic War===
[[File:Dxun.png|thumb|right|250px|Dxun wilderness]]
In the jungles of Dxun, the ruins of several abandoned research stations have been discovered and consequently, the labs were explored.<ref name="Forgotten">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Forgotten Knowledge}}</ref>

Around [[3627 BBY]], the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation's]] [[CI-004 Research Facility]] suffered an outbreak of [[Species/Legends|specimens]] and a strike team was [[CI-004 Incident|sent]] to handle the situation.<ref name="TOR-op" />

===New Sith Wars===
Millennia later, in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the Dark Lord of the Sith [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] began training his new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] on [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]]. Bane left Ruusan to find Freedon Nadd's tomb on Dxun after the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]]. Bane immediately recognized it as a world infused with the dark side. Inside Freedon Nadd's tomb, Bane acquired [[orbalisk armor]].<ref name="rot" /> By the time of Darth Bane, while the tomb and the well of darkness around it ranked as significant dark-side sites, the entire moon had become a dark-side site. Between the eras of Exar Kun and Darth Bane, Dxun was a common pilgrimage for those attempting to master the dark side of the Force.<ref name="DSSB">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Mars.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Mars, which Dxun's image was based upon in the minigame]]
Dxun first appeared in the comic [[Tales of the Jedi 1|''Tales of the Jedi'' 1]], written by [[Tom Veitch]]<ref name="totj1" /> and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]].<ref name="darkhorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/92-244/Star-Wars-Tales-of-the-Jedi-1-of-5|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi #1 (of 5)}}</ref>

The image of Dxun in the ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' Dxun/Onderon turret minigame resembles a mosaic of [[Wikipedia:Mars|Mars]] images taken by the ''[[Wikipedia:Viking 1|Viking 1]]'' orbiter on February 22, 1980.<ref name="Mars">[[:File:Mars.jpg|Image of Mars]]</ref>
